title: Deal Structure Limits by Kestrel Finance Tier
content:
Every Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts approval is structured inside the limits below for its credit tier: the amount financed, the loan-to-value ceiling, the down payment, the older-vehicle term limit, the odometer ceiling, the back-end product ceiling and the trade-in negative equity that can be rolled in.

## Amount financed, loan-to-value and down payment

| Tier | Minimum amount financed (USD) | Maximum amount financed (USD) | Maximum loan-to-value (percent of vehicle price) | Minimum down payment (percent of vehicle price) | Minimum down payment (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Finance Tier E | 5000.00 | 25000.00 | 100 | 15 | 1500.00 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier D | 5000.00 | 35000.00 | 110 | 10 | 1000.00 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier C | 5000.00 | 45000.00 | 115 | 10 | 1000.00 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier B | 5000.00 | 60000.00 | 120 | 5 | 500.00 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier A | 5000.00 | 85000.00 | 125 | 0 | 0.00 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier A+ | 5000.00 | 100000.00 | 130 | 0 | 0.00 |

The two down-payment columns work together: the down payment required is the larger of the percentage of the vehicle price and the dollar minimum.

## Vehicle age, odometer, back-end products and negative equity

| Tier | Older-vehicle model age (years) | Longest term on an older vehicle (months) | Maximum odometer at contract (miles) | Maximum back-end products (percent of vehicle price) | Maximum trade-in negative equity (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Finance Tier E | 7 | 48 | 150000 | 15 | 0.00 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier D | 7 | 48 | 150000 | 15 | 1500.00 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier C | 7 | 60 | 140000 | 20 | 2500.00 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier B | 7 | 60 | 140000 | 20 | 4000.00 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier A | 7 | 60 | 130000 | 25 | 6000.00 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier A+ | 7 | 60 | 130000 | 25 | 8000.00 |

Model age is the contract calendar year less the model year; the older-vehicle term limit applies at or above the model age shown. Back-end products are financed service contracts, GAP and maintenance plans taken together.

## Hypothetical illustrations

- Vehicle price 20000.00 at Tier E: 15 percent of the price is 3000.00, which is larger than the 1500.00 minimum, so the down payment required is 3000.00. At Tier B the same price gives 1000.00 against a 500.00 minimum, so 1000.00 is required.
- Vehicle price 8000.00 at Tier D: 10 percent is 800.00, smaller than the 1000.00 minimum, so 1000.00 is required.
- A vehicle with model age 7 at Tier C may be written for no more than 60 months; a vehicle with model age 6 is not subject to that limit.
- A vehicle showing 145000 miles at contract is within the Tier D ceiling of 150000 miles and above the Tier C ceiling of 140000 miles.
